title: ODNI claim that Dylan Borland drew a sensor system
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of ODNI claim that Dylan Borland drew a sensor system, about 2025-2026 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: directly from ODNI, is that Dylan Borland drew a fourth drawing of a sensor system.
>> Jeremy spoke about it. They created a fake force drawing and I have the text messages
tellings.difference: Borland tells it firsthand, calls the drawing fabricated and says he has text messages proving it.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same ODNI claim that Borland made a fourth drawing, which Corbell tells as a sensor-system drawing.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on UFO claims, says that word came directly from the ODNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, that a man named Dylan Borland had made a fourth drawing, this one of a sensor system. Corbell ties it to claims, around 2025 and 2026, about a craft said to be slowly heading toward Earth, and if true it would mean intelligence officials were shaping what witnesses and the public were told.
